duas.title: After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimin
duas.translation: All praise is due to Allah who has given us food and drink and made us Muslims

duas.title: Entering Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we depend

duas.title: Leaving Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except with Allah

duas.title: Entering the Masjid
duas.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy

duas.title: Leaving the Masjid
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty

duas.title: Seeking Protection
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

duas.title: Protection from Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammatin wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye

duas.title: General Gratitude
duas.translation: All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds

duas.title: Upon Receiving a Blessing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَزِدْنِي مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik li fihi wa zidni minhu
duas.translation: O Allah, bless it for me and increase it for me

duas.title: Seeking Forgiveness
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him

duas.title: Master of Seeking Forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am faithful to my covenant and my promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sins except You
duas.notes: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoever says this with firm belief in it during the day and dies that day before evening, he will be among the people of Paradise

duas.title: When Traveling
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
duas.translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. Surely, to our Lord we are returning
